title: Funnel Citadel Law
optimizationIntent: Take the Recursive Funnel Fabric and optimize it for maximum practical integrity, anti-bypass resistance, auditability, provenance, deterministic authority, recovery, isolation and premium operational clarity without pretending a same-origin/browser runtime is an invincible security boundary.
thesis: Make lawful execution the easiest path, unauthorized state transitions structurally difficult, every consequential decision attributable, and every failure containable.
invariants: Only the law kernel advances authoritative request state.
Every authoritative transition has a schema, provenance, predecessor and content hash.
No model, worker, UI, package or child Funnel can self-declare resolved, verified, promoted or authoritative.
Literal Sebastian evidence is distinct from solver consensus.
Synthetic consensus is never promoted into owner evidence.
Child Funnels receive scoped capabilities rather than ambient authority.
Parent state cannot be mutated by child failure.
Receipts bind law version, Page 0, resolved spec, dependencies, budget, parentage and ledger head.
Any relevant correction, dependency change or law-version change stales downstream authority.
Execution, verification and promotion are separate authorities.
Production promotion is explicit and two-phase.
Historical evidence is append-only; derived state may be compacted or rebuilt.
The kernel fails closed when integrity cannot be proven.

layers.job: Minimal deterministic state machine and authority root.
Versioned schemas, transition policies, capability types and promotion rules.
Append-only events, corrections, evidence, ballots, receipts and verification records.
Scoped solver/reviewer/build workers with no direct authority.

authorityModel.rule: Workers receive the minimum capability set and scope required for one task; no ambient write authority.

hardening: Reject unknown fields in authority-bearing schemas where practical.
Use monotonic sequence numbers and previous-event hashes.
Bind child receipts to parent question and budget snapshot.
Invalidate receipts on correction or changed dependency.
Separate draft, assembled, executable, verified and promoted states.
Quarantine malformed packages and unverifiable imported state.
Run historical regression corpus before law promotion.
Maintain a human-readable audit explanation for every authority decision.
faultContainment: Child failure receipts instead of parent mutation.
Circuit breakers for repeated worker/package failures.
Maximum resource consumption is determined by an explicit budget envelope.
Recovery reconstructs derived state from append-only authority records.
premiumExperience: Every blocked action explains exactly which law gate denied it.
Every receipt is inspectable in plain language and raw structured form.
Every architecture change has before/after diff, resource delta and affected dependency paths.
One-click trace from final result back to Page 0 and source evidence.
No silent fallbacks that change semantics.
Draft experiments are easy; production promotion is deliberate.
